The '''Bormus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]].
